description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'RolesApiResource' for managing application roles in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, enabling/disabling, and deleting roles, as well as managing role permissions.

classes.name: RolesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing roles and permissions in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveAllRoles
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all roles with optional field filtering.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new role with provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveRole
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific role by ID.

methods.name: actionsOnRoles
methods.description: Handles POST requests to enable or disable a role based on command query parameter.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing role with provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveRolePermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve permissions associated with a role.

methods.name: updateRolePermissions
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update permissions of a role.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a role by ID.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Utility method to check if command parameter matches a specific value.
